single.rationale: MFIC is a BDC experiencing deteriorating fundamentals with net income falling 36% year-over-year and operating cash flow turning significantly negative (-$49.7M in FY2025). Portfolio yields compressed from 10.8% to 9.7%, total return was negative (-4.3%), debt increased to $2.0B while equity declined, and ROE fell to just 4.8%. The company completed major mergers in 2024 which may create integration challenges, and operates in a competitive, rate-sensitive market with illiquid below-investment-grade holdings.
